resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground so Focus Lock Out can block the apps you chose during an armed focus session. It only reads app package names; it never reads screen content, text you type, or personal data, and nothing leaves your device.
Focus Lock Out needs these system permissions before it can enforce a lock. Each button opens the right Settings page.
Spots blocked apps the instant they open.
Enabled, but Android is not running the service. Turn it off and on again in Accessibility settings.
Lets the lock wall appear on top of blocked apps.
Backup detection, so a blocked app can\'t slip past the lock.
Shows the live countdown while a lock is armed.
Accessibility switch greyed out? Open App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".

Focus Lock Out uses the Accessibility Service API only to detect which app is currently in the foreground, so it can cover apps on your block list while a focus session is armed.\n\nIt does not read screen content, see what you type, or collect, store or share any personal data. You can turn it off at any time in Settings.
Grant the permissions above to arm the lock.
Pick at least one app to block.
For the next %1$d minutes your blocked apps are walled off. Getting in early means beating the %2$s, and apps can\'t be removed from the block list until the session ends.
Type an absurd 80–100 word passage with zero mistakes. Case and punctuation count.
Shake your phone 100 times. Your arms will hate you.
Needs an accelerometer, which this device doesn\'t have.
Solve 5 multi-step problems in a row. One miss resets the streak.
Beat the %1$s to end this session early.
Enforcement is offline: a required permission was revoked, so blocked apps are not being covered.
A lock is armed: you can add apps, but blocked apps stay blocked until the session ends.
Nice try. Apps stay blocked until the session ends.
You armed a focus lock. Whatever you were about to do can wait.
Passing gives you %1$d minutes in this app before the lock re-arms.
No accelerometer on this device, so the shake penalty became a math wall.
Type the passage below exactly. Every letter, capital, space and punctuation mark counts. Paste is disabled.
Wrong character at position %1$d. Fix it to keep going.
Paste blocked. Your thumbs got you here; they can type you out.
Shake your phone hard. Really commit.
Solve %1$d in a row. One wrong answer and the streak starts over with new problems.
Wrong. Streak reset: %1$d brand new problems.
You have %1$d minutes on %2$s. Then the lock re-arms.
Your focus session is over. The block list is lifted.
